title: build new refuses the id of a saved build and the id of an existing draft, before writing anything, and never overwrites a draft
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped core and templates; docs/decisions.md D7). The id of a saved build is `JITSO REJECTED: build "<id>" already exists (<layer> <path>): a draft needs an id no build has` (the same text as `build draft`); the id of an existing draft is `JITSO REJECTED: draft "<id>" already exists: edit .jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml or discard it`. Both exit 2 and are checked before anything is written, so a refused call leaves no folder behind, and an existing draft is never overwritten.
